caption: Figure 2: Ports of multiple ComponentPrototypes. 5.3 Clustering [TR_SWMG_0008] Functional elements that belong together shall also be represented in the model together. The AUTOSAR meta model provides several features to support clustering of model elements. For example, interfaces can contain multiple data elements, record data types and array data types can contain multiple elements. The use of structuring features improves the structure and comprehensibility of the model.
